LanguageData.DMS_GravekeeperStugna.label: Stugna missile
LanguageData.DMS_GravekeeperStugna.description: Fire one of the two Stugna anti-tank guided missiles racked on the shoulder launcher. The shaped charge punches through heavy armor, but locking on takes time and needs a clear line of sight. Each missile is replaced a day after it is fired.
